discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect
rationale: Topological insulators are a long-standing, heavily cited condensed-matter discovery: Kane-Mele theory (2005) plus Molenkamp's HgTe quantum-well experiment (2007). They build directly on the 2016 topology prize, have already won major precursor awards (Breakthrough, Dirac, Oliver Buckley), and fit after recent prizes in quantum circuits (2025), machine learning (2024) and attosecond physics (2023). Shoucheng Zhang's death in 2018 leaves a clean trio of theory and experiment.
